lead.purpose: The one supporting paragraph under a headline.

label.purpose: Used sparingly — not stacked above every section.

shadows.name: glass-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover state — edge highlight shifts to accent.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Frosted glass pill CTA with a cursor-tracked spotlight highlight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(160%) brightness(1.05); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.45), inset 0 -10px 16px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(124,92,255,0.9), inset 0 -10px 16px -10px rgba(124,92,255,0.5), 0 12px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4da3ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Dark frosted glass pill, secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; color: #e6edf3; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(13,17,23,0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4da3ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface, lifts and border-tints toward accent on hover — no shadow.
components.html:
Sin marca de agua

Tu transmisión sale limpia a cada plataforma.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161b22; border: 1px solid #2a3140; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; color: #e6edf3; font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #8b949e; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: #5a4bb8; }

components.name: Platform Badge
components.description: Circular ring container for a platform icon, colored per-platform.
components.css: .ds-badge { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }

narrative.overview:
Muxlyve's interface is a night-dark control room lit by a single accent: violet-blue light bending through glass. The hero shader is the thesis made literal — four platform-colored beams (Twitch, Kick, YouTube, TikTok) that read as pure white near the center and separate into color at the edges, like light through a prism. Every glass surface in the system — buttons, the mobile nav panel — carries that same idea forward: a cursor-tracked spotlight that makes the surface feel like it's catching real light, not painted with a gradient.

The palette stays almost monochrome (near-black bg, single violet accent) specifically so the four platform colors — which appear in badges, icons, and the shader — read as the interesting color event on the page, not competition for the brand's own accent. This is a technical product for streamers who know their tools; the visual language is confident and understated, not loud. No gradient text, no decorative color for its own sake.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black background with a single violet accent (Electric Violet), used sparingly
Frosted glass surfaces (backdrop-filter blur) with cursor-reactive spotlight highlights, not flat fills
Platform brand colors (Twitch/Kick/YouTube/TikTok) are the system's only permitted color variety, reserved for icons/badges/the hero shader
Pill-shaped buttons, soft-radius cards — no sharp corners anywhere

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric Violet is the only brand color used as UI accent. Platform colors are read-only — they represent the platforms, they don't decorate the UI.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter carries the entire type system. Hierarchy comes from weight and fluid clamp() scale, never from mixing in a second typeface.

rules.name: The Glass-Edge Rule
rules.body: Elevation on interactive glass surfaces comes from inset highlight/shadow pairs simulating a physical edge, never from a plain drop-shadow alone.

dos: Do use the inset-highlight glass-edge shadow pattern for any new elevated interactive surface — it's the system's one depth idiom.
Do keep platform colors scoped to platform representation only (icons, badges, the hero shader).
Do use grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr for auto-height reveal animations, animating any padding on the collapsing child in lockstep.
Do keep the eyebrow/label style rare and intentional, not stacked above every section.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient) for emphasis — solid Electric Violet does the job.
Don't introduce a second typeface. Inter's weight range carries the whole hierarchy.
Don't add drop-shadow-under-card as a depth pattern — cards lift via translateY + border-color, not shadow.
Don't hardcode hex colors outside this token set in new component CSS; reference the -- custom properties.
